segments.en: The vast Sea of Clouds...

A realm where life, matter...
all things are denied existence.

On the continents dotting the
Sea of Clouds, advanced
civilizations had flourished.

Cut off by the vast Sea of Clouds,
those civilizations had each
developed in their own way.
But...

the balance was shattered by a
pillar of light that suddenly
appeared beyond the Sea of Clouds...

From the light emerged a mysterious
army able to cross the Sea of Clouds,
once thought utterly inviolable.

Every continent was
drawn into the fighting,

and the whole world was engulfed
in the chaotic fires of war.

The Claudia Continent, struck by
a surprise attack from
the Sea of Clouds,

was helplessly occupied
by the mysterious army.

But the Claudians
entrusted their hopes
to a single ship...

and sent the Sea of Clouds survey
ship "Astante" out as an envoy
to the other civilizations.

The young crew of the "Astante"
met many people as they journeyed
on, calling for world peace.

Answering that call,
many heroes rose up,

and the heroes of every continent
came together as one.

Then they challenged the invaders
who had caused the war
to a final battle.

After a fierce struggle,
the heroes were victorious,

and the pillar of light that
linked the worlds was sealed away.

And so one heroic tale
came to an end,

and the world once again
marked the endless flow of time...

rows.notes: Test-pack recap of the previous game. [jp] 'pillar of light' as elsewhere in the corpus. Seg 4->5 kept as one sentence across pages ('But...' / 'the balance was shattered...'). | [editorial 9] line break split 'Sea / of Clouds'; reflowed

segments.en:
Enemy ship acquired,
at 11 o'clock.
Distance: 44,000.
Confirm the ship type, please.
Roger!

Ship type confirmed:
Norstan Kai-class,
the "Aryuz."

Here they come...
So the commander is the
veteran, Ms. Tail...

Enemy units!
They're crossing the alert line!

Captain Rie!
There's been a hacking attack on our
system, apparently from the enemy ship!

System firewall activated!
Intrusion level: Rank E.

Support system!
Switch to Protect Mode!
Roger!

Greeting us right
off the bat, huh...

Even if it's just an exercise,
I can't let my guard down...

Oh... Captain Rie,
what about our onboard mechs?

Don't you need to
tell your brother?

Oh, right!
Big Bro--!

...K-Kanji-- Squad Leader Kanji
reported that the FT maintenance
was done, didn't he?
I haven't heard anything......

Ugh, honestly!
That airhead~!

Oh... so it was no good
after all.
I'm sorry...

It's not your fault, Lun!
Reporting is the squad leader's job!
Is it?

Anyway!
Check on the situation, please.

Um...
Looks like he's in the cockpit.
I'll go ask him.

Don't hold back! You've gotta
give that guy a real piece
of your mind!
Ro~ger!

Whew...
Finally done.

Hey, you~
Kanji~!
Oh! Lun!

Good timing.
I just finished the adjustments.
Thanks for all your hard work!

But I'm sorry... you were
supposed to report in
a little sooner...

I didn't pass that on to you,
Kanji, so...
I'm really sorry.

Hey now, tuning my machine
is my job. It's nothing
you need to worry about, Lun.

Huh?
But......

Loosen up a little more.
We're not at war now.
Yeah... you're right.
But I'm fine, really!

Hahaha! You've always had
way more guts than me
anyway, Lun.

If Rie starts whining about
anything, you let her have it!

A... Aha...
Ahahaha... haha...

"Let her have it," my foot!!
Why, you...! You lazy
slacker of a squad leader!!
Gwah!!

You were supposed to have
maintenance finished
two hours ago!!

And why should Lun
have to apologize anyway?!

You're the one who's
supposed to report, Big Bro!!
Ahahaha......

Well, don't get
so worked up!
Grrrr~~~!

Why, Big Bro, are you always,
always, always...
ALWAYS like this~!!
Now listen~!

It's about time you quit
with that "Big Bro" stuff.
It's embarrassing!

Oh?
What's wrong with it...?
It's more natural on this ship.

No, it undermines her
authority as captain...

Big Br...!
Y-You're the last person
I want to hear that from!!

Now, now...
Let's save the debriefing
for later, okay?

More importantly, Captain Rie,
it's almost time to enter
phase 3 of the exercise.

Oh, I'm sorry.
Let's begin the transition.

Honestly, getting dragged along
by Big Bro throws me
completely off my pace!

Yeah, that's right.
Quit fussing over me and
hurry up and do your job!

I'm busy all year round!
Don't go causing trouble!!

Couldn't Rie stand to
loosen up a little?

Now then... I think I'll
take it easy until the
sortie order comes.

I've been with this machine
for a long time now...
The battle to seal the pillar of light...

I traveled the vast Sea of Clouds
in this machine.

And I'm still
riding it...

Even though the world...
was supposed to be at peace now......

Kanji!
Is Kanji here?
Oh, Professor Rondo!
(This is Professor Rondo...)

(He's a superb pilot, and also the
 scientist who developed a groundbreaking
 Sea of Clouds navigation system...)

(The professor's also the one
 who designed the FT I pilot.)
(If it weren't for him...)

(we'd never have been able
 to put up a real fight...)
Are the FT adjustments done?

Yep!
This thing's been in
a good mood lately.

Heh... Impressive.
I suppose there's no need for
me to maintain it anymore.

Oh, no~ I'm not quite
there yet...

Come now...
Don't go thinking I'll be
on this ship forever.

This machine
is yours now.

I'm counting on you,
Squad Leader Kanji!!
Yes, sir!!

We will now begin
the combat drill.

The aim of this combat drill is
to get used to operating
the new system.

Regardless of skill level, all
personnel will follow the basic
drill program.

Onboard mech pilots, step away
from your cockpits and stand by
until further orders.
That is all!

She's sure fired up,
that Rie...

Hey! Kanji,
she is the captain, after all.

Haha!
I know, I know!

Drill program has
entered phase 3.
Crossing the F Line.

3, 2, 1...
Phase 3 of the drill begins!

All ri~ght...
I've gotta do my best!

Attention, all hands!
Everyone to your
battle stations!

rows.notes: Prototype sequel scene: Rie is the ship's captain ([jp] -> 'Captain Rie'), Kanji the squad leader ([jp] -> 'Squad Leader Kanji') to keep the two apart. [jp] (Rie) -> 'Miss Lun'; [jp] -> 'Ms. Tail'. [jp] = UI 'Combat Drill'. Seg 16: Rie corrects herself from [jp] to [jp]. Seg 20: Lun's apology implies she was supposed to relay the report request (confirmed by segs 32-33). Seg 32 subject restored as 'you' (Kanji) from seg 33. Seg 54: 'her' = Rie (captain). Seg 72: [jp] -> 'cloud-sea nav system' (compressed to fit). Seg 82 'Squad Leader Kanji' from Prof. Rondo. | [accuracy 21] late decision: Rie's [jp] = plain 'Lun' | [accuracy 45] late decision: Rie's [jp] = plain 'Lun' | [accuracy 72] project term [jp] = Sea of Clouds (was 'cloud-sea nav system') | [editorial 7] unnatural 'We've had a hack on our system' | [editorial 45] style sheet: '?!' not '!?' | [editorial 55] doubled punctuation '--...'; cut-off kept

segments.en:
The mock battle
will now begin.

Send the drill program to every
unit scheduled to sortie!
Sending the program now.
Oh, here it comes.

So far, so good!
You're doing great,
Lun!

Oh, Kanji...
Did it get to you all right?

Yeah!
It came through perfectly!
Um... Kanji?
What?

I went to the trouble of sending it,
so read it properly, okay?

Hahaha...
I know.

Okay then...
Guess I'll start up the program
Lun sent me.

So it starts with the basic controls?
What a pain~

But it's Lun asking me,
not just anyone.
Guess I'll just have to grin and bear it...

A simple explanation of the
controls will now be given.

Please follow the guide
as you play.

Heh heh...! I'll take a good
look at how much those
kids have grown...

We'll be in attack range shortly!
All units, prepare to sortie!
It's almost time...

Nelfea! You probably know already,
but the enemy leader
is Kanji Akatsuki.

His machine is the FT
"Cloud Saber."

If he flies at high altitude,
shooting him down with a ground-combat GT
is next to impossible.

I'll try provoking him anyway.
If he's the cocky type,
he might come down.

I wish I could've gotten you
an FT too, instead of a GT...

I don't mind.
I'm used to this machine.

Against Kanji, it's just
the right handicap.

Honestly...
what a girl you are...
Auntie Tail!

Don't treat me like a child
while I'm carrying out a mission...!

Haha...
I'm sorry.

But don't get the wrong idea.
I just thought you seemed
reliable, that's all.
Heh... Thanks.

Now... let's go!
My GT-K!
Launching!!

Don't get cocky just because
you've got air superiority.

I'll show you what this
machine can really do!

We'll buy time with the GT-O
against attacks from the air!

Meanwhile, Nelfea,
charge in from the ground.
Roger!

We're ready.
Here we go!

Listen,
Big Bro.

In battle, whoever sinks the other
side's mothership first wins.

No matter how many units you
have left, if your mothership
goes down, you lose.

Roger. So I just have to hit
the enemy mothership fast.

Also, the enemy mothership
has no units that are good
at aerial combat.

So you should take your
Cloud Saber and attack
from the air, Big Bro.

I know something that basic
without you spelling
it out every time.

Well, of course you do.
You ARE the "combat leader."
Okay, I'm counting on you!

All right!
Here I go!!
That concludes mech-to-mech combat.

Please remember the order:
"Sortie" -> "Move" -> "Attack."

You've gotten better,
Kanji!

But now
it's our turn.

Nelfea's unit has broken
through the defense line!

That leaves our
mothership wide open!

We have to launch
interceptors right away!

rows.notes: Tutorial battle. [jp] -> 'combat leader' (as used elsewhere). Seg 22: [jp] 'ground GT'. Seg 27 [jp] -> 'you're such a kid' to set up Nelfea's reply. [jp] -> 'Sortie' (UI string for [jp] is still blank in elf_strings; 'Move' matches UI). Seg 40 soldier's line kept generic. | [editorial 4] 'Going smoothly, smoothly!' unnatural for [jp] | [editorial 27] sets up Nelfea's 'Don't treat me like a child' (translator's intent per row note); 'what a girl you are' lost the link

segments.en: Well, that's how it's done.

That went well,
Kanji!

Yeah, thanks to
your support, Lun.
Hehe, thanks!

Whew~!
Working up a sweat made me hungry.

Okay, okay!
I'll have something to eat
ready and waiting.

That's my Lun!
Always so thoughtful.

Um~
Squad Leader Kanji?

The bridge is about to get
busy preparing to dock.

Don't be such a killjoy.
You can handle docking
by yourself, right?

Ah, ah~!
I take back what I said!

I still have work to do!
I'll take my break after we dock!

Good for you,
Lun!

So that's how it is.
Got that, Squad Leader Kanji?

Tch!
Fine.

Hehe~
Too ba~d for you~

Dammit!
What a bratty
little sister!

Of all people,
she has to be my superior...

Isn't this assignment some
plot by Dad and Rie? No,
it's definitely a plot!

Lun,
be careful.

That guy sweet-talks people and
then bosses them around for
his own selfish ends.

Don't let him talk you
into things like just now!

Sorry~
I'm kind of spacey...
Aha... haha...

We lost after all,
huh...

Even with that lineup, it seems
they can at least do the
bare minimum.

Next time, I'll take them on
at a slightly higher level.

They look like they'll make
good sparring partners.

Hmph...
I suppose it can't be helped...

There's no one else worth
fighting at the moment...

Come on, we're
docking too.

rows.notes: Win version of the drill aftermath. [jp] -> 'dock'. | [accuracy 0] [jp] after a win = satisfied 'that's about what you'd expect', not 'that's all' | [accuracy 12] late decision: Rie's [jp] = plain 'Lun' | [accuracy 19] late decision: Rie's [jp] = plain 'Lun' | [editorial 13] [jp] is 'understood?' -- 'Got it, ...!' read as Rie saying she understood | [editorial 18] 'has to be a plot... No, it's definitely' didn't work; restores the question -> self-answer shape of [jp]

segments.en:
Dammit...
We lost...?

Your skills are all
beyond reproach.

I believe the cause of this
defeat was our failure to keep
the squad in step.

As captain, this defeat
is my responsibility...
Captain Rie...
Rie...

Also, we will hold a debriefing
immediately after landing at base.

The combat leader will compile
a report on this battle and
attend the debriefing.

What a dra~g.
Let's do some more realistic
training instead~

Kanji!
That's enough out of you!
Yes, ma'am!
Pathetic as ever.

Losing to us, when we're clearly
the weaker force...

Captain Rie, you still don't
seem used to the new system.

I have no excuse,
Ms. Tail.

Heh heh heh...
You're going to get chewed
out once you're back at base~
Hahaha...

Captain Rie,
we have a transmission from HQ.

Sigh...
Put it through.

What was that?!
That battle just now!!
You're getting slack!
Yes, sir...

What?
You look dissatisfied, Rie.
...Not at all, sir.

Hmph!
I can tell exactly
what you're thinking.

Listen, Rie! Keeping Kanji in
line is your job, as the one in
charge of the whole unit.

Yes, sir!
I'm terribly sorry!!

Everyone needs remedial training.
I'll whip you all back into shape!
Thank you, sir!

Good!
After the debriefing, Captain Rie
will report to HQ!
Roger!
Sigh...

Your father's strict, isn't he?
Even though he's usually so kind.

We're family, so he doesn't
hold back. Especially on duty...

But it's because he's
thinking of us.
I guess so...

(Being able to see your father
 that way...
 I'm a little jealous...)

(I only realized it after
 I couldn't see him anymore...)

rows.notes: Loss version. [jp] (Lun) -> 'Rie' (honorific dropped). [jp] -> 'debriefing'. Seg 10 'Yes, ma'am!' = Kanji answering Lun's scolding. Seg 36: 'him' = Lun's father ([jp], seg 35). | [editorial 13] direction: [jp] is vocative (Rie answers 'I have no excuse, Ms. Tail'); third-person phrasing read as an aside | [editorial 19] style sheet: '?!' not '!?'

segments.en:
...All right, that concludes
the debriefing.

Everyone, keep in mind the
points written in the report.
Dismissed!

Whew~!
Done and done!

Lun!
Let's go.

Oh... not yet.
The bridge crew still has
some follow-up work.

Oh, right...
Then I'll be waiting
at the usual place.
Okay!

Big Bro,
wait a sec!
If you're going to the hangar...

I know.
Back up the combat data
so far, right?
Seriously, don't forget.
You got it!

Now then~ I'd better
record our progress so far.

rows.notes: Save-prompt lead-in (backup of battle data = save).

segments.en: All set!

Now I just have to
wait for Lun to show up.

She's late......
What's Lun doing...
Kanji! Sorry I'm late!
I got tired of waiting.

Ehehe... Sorry~
I'm still not used
to the work yet.

You were helping Rie out even
before you joined the military.

Bridge work isn't
new to you, is it?

It's different when it's
your actual job, you know...

Plus the bridge systems were
completely overhauled...
It's tough.
Oh, that's right...

Hm?
What's wrong?
Did something happen?
Hey, um...
Hm?

Look... I really do want
you to leave the ship, Lun.
Huh... Why?

'Cause... you wanting to join
the military, Lun... It's just
not right!
Let's not talk about that...
But Lun... you're...

That's right...
Me, in the military...!
Lun...

You don't like
the military either,
do you, Kanji?
Well, no...

Then, Kanji...
quit the military.
If you did, I'd...

Ridding the world of weapons
is going to take a lot longer.

Until then... I think
protecting the peace we
have now is my job.
Hey... Do you remember?

Something I asked you,
Kanji, a long time ago...

Hey, Kanji, why did you
decide to become
an FT pilot?
Let's see...

Because of Dad, maybe?
Dad was a pilot too.

But... maybe it really
just happened that way...

I grew up in a time without war,
so it wasn't like I wanted to
protect Claudia or anything.
Yeah, that's how it was...

My reason for becoming a pilot...
it was really no more than that.

But... I changed
once I'd been through battle.

There are still lots of people
in this world who want
to threaten the peace...
And I... came to know that.

I know...
Now that you're involved, you
can't look the other way, right?
Yeah...

That's why I volunteered.
Because I want
to follow you...
Lun...

Do you have some kind
of dream for the future, Lun?
Let's see...

Living together with
someone precious to me,
and growing old slowly...

A life like that...
is my dream, I guess?

Just kidding!
Ahahaha!

Heeey,
wait up, Lun!

(Lun hasn't changed
 all that much since then.)

(Maybe...
 the one who's changed
 is me...)

(Did Lun... understand that
 about me... and volunteer for
 the military on purpose?)

Argh!
This is no time for this.
I've gotta go after Lun!

rows.notes: Segs 34-38 and 48-53 read as a flashback to an earlier conversation (Lun's question, Kanji's answer); seg 39 is Kanji in the present. Seg 23 [jp] kept elliptical ('Me, in the military...!'): she concedes the army is not for her. Seg 40 takes 'my reason' (his own), reading [jp] as Kanji reflecting on his answer.

segments.en:
Hm?
Is that...?
Heeey!
Oh, Kanji.
Hm?

What's wrong?
You seem down.

Um... look...
I'm sorry... about earlier.

We already talked about you joining
the military before... and I went
and dragged it up again.

No,
I should be apologizing too.
Why's that?

Ehehe... because I knew
you'd come looking for me!
Why, you~

Come on, let's
go for a walk.

It's been a while since
I got off the ship.

Hahaha... You really
do love walks, Lun.
Yep!

(Whew...
 Looks like she's back
 to her usual cheerful self.)

(Then again...
 Lun's always looking
 out for me...)

Kanji~!
Over here! Over here!
Coming!!

rows.notes: Seg 10: Lun apologizes because she ran off expecting him to come find her (reason implied, kept as in source).

segments.en:
Oh!
If it isn't Rie.
What are you doing?

What does it look like...
I'm on my way back from
reporting to HQ.

What's up?
You're not snapping at
me like usual.

That must've been rough...
They said all kinds of
things to you at HQ, huh?
Oh... no, not really.

You must be tired.
Why don't we go have
tea somewhere?

Hehe.
My treat!

Reeeally?!
Then I know a great place!

I wanna eat their
Jumbo Strawberry Parfait!

Hehe.
Sure, whatever you like.
Yay!

Hey... Rie,
I can't eat that much
sweet stuff.

Then you can just order
something else, Big Bro.

You... can eat one of
those by yourself?

Huh?
Aren't you supposed to eat
it by yourself?

Hey... are you serious?
Where in that tiny body
would it even go...

Ehe, when it comes to sweets,
I've always got room!

Hehe,
sounds like fun.
Let's go!

Fine, fine.
Let's go watch Rie
turn into a monster.

Well, it's a bit of
a walk from here, but
we'll be back by evening.
Right, by evening...
By... evening......

What's wrong,
Rie?

Uuugh~
I still have work to do.

Lun, I'm sorry.
Ask me again next ti~me!

Aw, a little while
won't hurt, will it?

Let's do the work tonight.
If there's anything I can
help with, I'll do it.

Thank you...
But I can't do that~
Oh... Rie...?

Hey, this is the only free time
we've got. Can't you put
work off for once?

Oh... don't worry about it.
I'll take a bunch of
time off later!

Big Bro!
Make sure you take Lun
to that shop, okay!

Like I said, we can't
finish one of those!

Ah...
She's gone.

She really looked like
she wanted to eat it, too.

Rie...
She hasn't taken any time off
the whole exercise period...

She takes on every job,
even ones she doesn't need to.

Looking after people has
become a habit for her.

Aren't you the one she looks
after most, dear Big Brother
Kanji?

Huh?
Ahahahaha...

I'm worried...
I think I'll go help
her after all.
Yeah, good idea...

Well, guess I'll head
back to the ship.

rows.notes: [jp] (Lun) -> 'Rie'. Seg 41 [jp] = Lun teasing Kanji -> 'dear Big Brother Kanji'. Seg 35 [jp] -> 'we' (Kanji and Lun). | [accuracy 27] late decision: Rie's [jp] = plain 'Lun' | [accuracy 34] late decision: Rie's [jp] = plain 'Lun' | [editorial 8] style sheet: '?!' not '!?' | [editorial 40] 'people's turned' parsed as a possessive; clarity

segments.en: Hey! Kanji! So there you are.
Ugh... That's my dad's voice.

I've got a job for you, Kanji. We need the
supplies on this list, and fast!

There's no time. Take your FT and go pick
them up!
Sorry, Dad... but I'm busy.

The place is Zaxel Pass, North Gate 23.
Got that? And here are the papers you'll
need to sign for the shipment.
Hey! Don't rush off! You forgot the papers!

I didn't forget! I was just casually
walking away.
Never mind that, just take them!
H-Hey...!
Hey! I'm not in your unit, Dad!

How many times have I told you not to call
me Dad while on duty!

Listen! You will complete this mission
within 60 minutes.
On the double!!
Dammiiit!!

Okay, Gate 23 should be somewhere around
here...

Was there ever a reception desk out
here...?
Kanji!

There's no one in the office right now, so
I, Tail Kinui, will be handling reception
in their place.
Oh... Ms. Tail! Thanks for covering!

You sure are quick. It didn't even take you
five minutes to get here from the port,
did it?
Well, that's only natural for an FT!
Heh... You certainly talk big.
By the way, did you bring the papers?
Ah, yes.
Very good! Now, come over here.
Roger!

I want you to carry this container to the
port.

It might be a little big, but an FT's
thrust can handle it, right?

Yes, it'll be fine as long as I don't lose
my balance.
Well, I'm sure that's no trouble for you.

Take the cargo to the place written on this
memo.
Hm...? I'm not taking it to my dad's ship?
That paper... would you read it properly?
Oh, right!

...Oh, there's something written at the
bottom. Let's see...

(Listen, Kanji. Keep quiet and load this
 container onto the "Astante II"!)

(Not a word about this to anyone.
          -- Kyo Akatsuki)

Dad, huh... What the heck is this all
about?!
Well then, I'm counting on you.
Understood!
(It's lighter than I expected...)
(It doesn't seem to be packed full...)
Still... I wonder what's inside.
Are you curious, Big Bro?
Whoa! Don't just pop up out of nowhere!

And anyway...! Weren't you supposed to be
busy? You'd better have finished your
work!
This is part of my work!
Huh?

Don't tell me... You're in cahoots with Dad
again?

Heh heh... You're dying to know, aren't
you?
Of course I am!
Let's see... What should I do?
Hey! Rie! Quit fooling around!!

Aw, I'm only joking. Nobody's around right
now, so you can go ahead and open it.
Right, then let's open it up.
Th-This is...!

No doubt about it... It's the FT I used
before I started flying the
"Cloud Saber"...

The FT-ZX7... It's the very "Impulse 7"
you used to fly, Big Bro.
Well? Does it bring back memories?
Yeah... But what on earth is going on here?

So this thing has to be brought aboard
in secret?

I don't know the reason either. But knowing
Dad, he must have something in mind.

It'll probably all turn out to be needless
worry... That's what Dad told me...

We can't use it in the drills either, so
maybe it'll just sit here and never move
at all...

Rie! Get us a good stock of spare parts for
this thing and the "Cloud Saber."

And don't forget to put in a request for
ammo. Make up some excuse for it!
Um... Sure, but what's wrong?

Nothing's wrong. I'm going to start tuning
my machine. I'm counting on you for the
rest!

What's gotten into him all of a sudden...
Big Bro...

Maybe Dad put on an act so Big Bro would
take the drills seriously...?

These machines have been deployed:
FT-ZX7 "Impulse 7" x1
GT-O "Overhead" x1
The ship's equipment has been reinforced.
Phew... That should about do it...
Oh no! I'd better get back to the bridge!
Oh, welcome back, Captain Rie!
I'm ba~ack!

Three hours until departure. Let's
double-check the system adjustments.
Um, Rie?
Hm? What is it?

...Kanji's acting strange. It's as if he's
about to go into battle...
Oh, that?

Don't worry. Dad just gave him a kick in
the pants, that's all!

But... I... somehow I've got this strange,
uneasy feeling.

Whaaat?! When you say something like that,
Lun, it makes me really worried!
...Oh... Does it?
Ah, sorry for saying something weird.

It's just been bothering me a little,
that's all.
Even Lun... What's gotten into her...?

...Oh well. A little tension like this is
just right.

Okay, everyone, let's begin the final
check!
Roger!

(I don't know why, but I've got a bad
 feeling about this...)

(I'd better be ready to fight at any
 moment...)

rows.notes: [1] Kanji recognizes his father's voice offscreen. [5] [jp] = papers to take receipt of the supplies. [40]-[41] Kyo's written note: kept in parentheses as in the JP; signature indented with spaces and '--'. [70] [jp] read as 'stock up on spare parts' for both machines. [76] system message: kept the source's list layout (no standard UI string found for [jp]). | [accuracy 90] Rie's honorific for Lun -> plain 'Lun' (late decision 2026-11-01: they are peers) | [accuracy 94] Rie's honorific for Lun -> plain 'Lun' (late decision 2026-11-01: they are peers) | [editorial 22] natural greeting: gokurousama to someone covering reception (k21); 'Thanks for your hard work' read as translationese | [editorial 38] 'Ah, yes!' read as recalling something; Kanji is responding to being told to read the paper | [editorial 42] question punctuation (?!) | [editorial 65] surprised confirmation as in JP (accuracy flag k65), not a 'why' question | [editorial 94] 'What's gotten into Lun, too...' was awkward; Lun is female | [proofread 61] line break no longer splits the quoted name "Cloud Saber" | [proofread 70] punctuation inside the closing quote (unit/corpus convention, as in _00 "Aryuz.")

segments.en: Departure preparations complete.

Good work. Now we just wait for
instructions from the control tower.
Huh? What's this transmission...?
Lun, what's wrong?

I've picked up a strange broadcast. It's
cutting into the whole nationwide network
at top priority...

We've picked it up here too. With that
priority... it must be some kind of
government emergency broadcast...
Can you put it on the main monitor?
Yes...
They say it's a special broadcast!
I wonder what's going on...
Anyway, let's go check it out!

Through repeated great wars, mankind has
turned most of Claudia into barren land.

We who survived surely have a duty to do
everything in our power to bring that land
back to life!
And yet!!

Twenty years have passed since Claudia was
united under the Unified Government...
Has the situation improved?
The answer is NO!

Certainly, the great cities around the
world have recovered beyond anything seen
before...

But that is nothing more than a vain facade
created by economic activity that pursues
profit alone!

Reckless development to extract our
dwindling resources is steadily destroying
Claudia's nature!!

So long as mankind refuses to let
civilization regress, Claudia is doomed...

Various new technologies have extended its
life somewhat, but they will not save it in
time!

Mankind's growth can no longer be contained
within the Claudia Continent.

And yet the current Unified Government
forbids anyone to fly out into the Sea of
Clouds...

Worse still, the government has kept all
information about the new continents beyond
the Sea of Clouds hidden!
And why is that?!!

Because certain factions in the government
and the military have been secretly trading
with other continents!

They monopolize the enormous profits from
that trade and keep them for themselves!

To break this deadlock, we have left the
Unified Forces and formed a new army!

We will cross the Sea of Clouds and become
the foundation that lets all people meet
and interact with the new world.

It is lamentable that we have had to take
up arms to achieve this ideal.
However!

Unless we overthrow the Unified Forces, who
rule Claudia with their overwhelming
military might,
we can never take flight into the future!

As of this moment, our army declares war on
the Unified Government!!
Wh-What is this...
He's got it all completely backwards!
Is it... going to turn into a war again?

I have a feeling it's going to be a really
big one...

We don't know the enemy's strength, so I
can't say anything for now...

This is Nelfea. I'm landing on the Astante
II!
Hey, wait a second, Nelfea!
Hangar crew, clear the deck now!!

rows.notes: [6] the NCO speaks with feminine sentence endings; gender left unstated in English. [12]-[34] Binzvanker's speech: [jp] 'Unified Government', [jp] 'Unified Forces'. [36] [jp] read as Rie saying his accusations reverse the truth. | [accuracy 4] Rie's honorific for Lun -> plain 'Lun' (late decision 2026-11-01: they are peers) | [editorial 25] rhetorical question punctuation (?!!)

segments.en:
That Nelfea...! She forced a landing on
our ship!!
Wh-What's going on?!

If we stay on the ground, we'll get hit by
a first strike! Take off right now!!

Rie! I've tuned the system. We can go at
maximum battle speed!!
Y-Yes, sir!
Astante II, emergency launch!!

Level 1 alert!! Seal the bulkheads in every
block!!
Multiple missiles incoming!!
Rapid ascent!!
Near miss! Damage is light!!

I've located the ship that seems to have
fired the missiles!

It's a brand-new "Balket-class"
battleship!
Its name?
The jamming's too heavy! I can't tell!

So that's the famous "Astante II"...
What incredible reaction speed...

Captain, our strategic objective has been
achieved.
Don't engage that ship. Full retreat!

Hard about! We're withdrawing to Cecibel
Base!
The enemy ship is retreating!
Retreating?! What's going on...?

Transmission from the base. Putting it
through now.
Rie, what's your status?
This ship is undamaged.

Good! Then hurry to where the enemy fleet
is gathering.
You know where the enemy is?

The enemy's main force is around Cecibel
Base.

The garrison fleets stationed in each
region are apparently gathering there one
after another, too...
How big is the enemy fleet?

Its full size is unknown, but it's
certainly large enough to take control of
all of Claudia.
No way...! Couldn't they be dummies?

Unidentified vessels have been sighted.
I don't know where they got them from,
but...
No...

Commander Tsuragi's main fleet is already
on the move.

I want all of you to reach the area ahead
of the main fleet and keep watch on the
enemy's movements.

I'll gather the forces from the nearby
bases and follow you!
Roger!

The Astante will now head for Cecibel Base
at full speed.

Listen! Even if fighting breaks out, buy
time until the main force arrives.

Whatever you do, don't push yourselves too
hard.
I understand.
Come on! Kanji, you're in the way! Move!!
Hey! Nelfea! What's the big idea?!
This isn't your unit, is it?
You need reinforcements, don't you?

Instead of asking stupid questions, adapt
to the situation!
Nelfea has joined the unit.
One GT-K has been deployed.

(Professor Rondo's niece...
 Nelfea Northrock...)

(I'd like to call her a reliable ally,
 but she's such a brat...)

Sorry, Kanji. She may be a cheeky girl, but
put her to good use.

Well... I kinda feel like I'm the one who's
gonna get used...

Hahahahaha! Well, that's just her way of
saying she acknowledges you.

I'm going out too! I'll be borrowing the
"Impulse 7."

What, you too, Professor? But that machine
still needs maintenance...!

Who do you think I am?! Let's start
checking every machine aboard!
Roger!

Uncle! I'm finished over here. I'll help
you!
Thanks...

Kanji, that's enough here. Take care of the
other machines.
Got it!
Dammit! So it's war!!
This ship will now head for Cecibel Base.

Lun, please display the marker on the
navigation map.
Yes, putting it on the monitor.

Okay, Lun, I'll leave the helm to you
from here on.

Whaaat? I can't do that yet! This isn't a
drill anymore!

There's no time for practice. You'll learn
to steer the ship by doing it!

Oh... Understood, Captain! I'll give it a
try!

rows.notes: [22] [jp] rendered as a status request. [33] [jp] not in glossary: romanized 'Commander Tsuragi'. [44] Nelfea (normally with another unit, cf. Tail's ship in the previous slice) boards to reinforce. [49] [jp] = niece; Nelfea calls Rondo [jp] -> 'Uncle' [58]. | [accuracy 64] Rie's honorific for Lun -> plain 'Lun' (late decision 2026-11-01: they are peers); headerless page, Rie continuing from [63] | [accuracy 66] Rie's honorific for Lun -> plain 'Lun' (late decision 2026-11-01: they are peers) | [editorial 48] system line: no sentence-initial numeral; '<X> has been deployed.' form | [editorial 56] question punctuation (?!) | [proofread 54] punctuation inside the closing quote (unit/corpus convention, as in _00 "Aryuz.")

segments.en:
We've drifted off course from the target.
Correcting our heading.
Oh, I'm sorry...

rows.notes: Rie corrects the course while Lun is at the helm (cf. row 11 [66]-[69]).

segments.en:
We're approaching the airspace over
Cecibel Base.
Phew... Looks like we somehow made it...
Nice work.

That's only because you backed me up,
Captain.

We're about to enter the combat zone, so
I'll take over the helm now.
Oh, right.
With this, history will accelerate...

Rochina, a battle between Claudian fleets
is about to take place.

I want you to judge whether our army can
stand on equal terms with other military
powers.

I believe I already understand this fleet's
capabilities quite well.

This one battle will show every officer and
soldier in our army that the plan can be
realized.
Indeed...!

The ships that were headed for Astante
Fortress have returned.

Omega's unit, eh... It seems the
"provocation" succeeded.

rows.notes: [7] [jp] -> 'Rochina' (honorific dropped).

segments.en:
Kanji Akatsuki... So he's the Cloud Saber's
pilot...

It'll be interesting to see how the Astante
crew deals with this situation...
...What is it? Fine, come in!
Excuse me!

As of today, I have been assigned to serve
as your secretary, Lord Omega.

You're the woman from Binzvanker's personal
secretariat, aren't you?

I'm honored. I never thought you would
remember me.

Don't get the wrong idea. I've been trained
to remember such things.
But I don't recall asking for a secretary.

I have orders from Commander Binzvanker...
to keep watch on you, Lord Omega.

Heh heh heh... How honest of you...
But it's pointless.
No one can keep track of my movements.
I am well aware of that.

In fact, it was I who proposed this
assignment to the Commander.

What did you say? Hoh... What is it you
want?

Ten years from now...... your power
will set this world in motion.

In my own small way... I would like to help
you with that.

Fuhahahahahahahaha! Don't get the wrong
idea. I'm just a capricious man.

I'm not thinking about anything years down
the road.
Then I shall guide you.
Heh! Heh-hahahahaha!!

rows.notes: [7] [jp]: read as Omega being trained to remember faces/people, i.e. his remembering her means nothing personal. [9] [jp] -> 'Commander Binzvanker'. | [editorial 15] 'begin to move by your power' was stiff; same meaning

segments.en:
The enemy's right in front of us... What's
Rie dawdling for?

True. Waiting for the main force to arrive
would be the standard move,
but this time, your instincts are right.
...Huh?
We're going to the bridge!
Whoa! Hey! D-Don't pull me!
Hurry! Follow me!
Yeah, yeah!

Yo! How's it looking? What's the enemy
doing?
Ah, Big Bro!

You know better than that, Big Brother.
You're supposed to stay in the hangar.
Ah... well, there's a reason for this...

Lun! Let me see the footage of the enemy
fleet.
Ah! Don't touch that without asking!
You're so slow I can't stand watching!
Ugh...

Those are all enemy ships... There sure are
a lot of 'em.

Once the main force arrives, it'll turn
into a melee. Before that, we should probe
that fleet in force as much as we can.

We'd learn the enemy's strength, and if all
goes well, we can hit their flagship.

So we cut in with a single ship and throw
the enemy formation into disarray.

That way, the main force coming after us
can deploy with the advantage.

You seem to understand. So why aren't you
charging in?

Until just a little while ago... they were
our allies.

We might still be able to settle this...
through negotiation...

You heard that speech. It was full of
lies, wasn't it?

And you still think they're people you can
negotiate with?
It's true, it was awful...

Everything we've done for peace got twisted
into something evil...

Yeah... We got no chance to argue back.
He just said whatever he wanted about us.
But for that many ships to gather...

It means lots of people believe that
speech, doesn't it...?

That's why we've got to take down the
ringleader, Binzvanker, ourselves.
With just one ship?

Yes... Strike at the enemy's core, sharp as
a needle... Isn't that the way to keep the
casualties as low as possible?

That's no different from settling things
by force! I don't think we should fight!

Lun! This is a warship! You're a nuisance
if that's all the resolve you have!
Even so, I...!
Stop it, both of you!

Fine... There's no time to argue. Let's
leave it to the captain.

Do we keep waiting here, or do we charge
in? Make a clear decision, one way or the
other!
...We'll go with Nelfea's plan.
Rie...

rows.notes: [10] Lun's teasing [jp] to Kanji -> 'Big Brother' (vs Rie's 'Big Bro'). [17] [jp] = reconnaissance in force ('probe in force'). [25] [jp] split as 'You heard that speech. It was full of lies'. [43] [jp] -> 'Rie'. | [editorial 42] 'I'm adopting Nelfea's plan' stiff for a spoken captain's decision

segments.en:
We will now attempt to close in on the
enemy fleet!

All hands, take your battle stations at
once!
Roger!

Report from a picket ship! One enemy
battleship is approaching!
Just one? Isn't it one of ours?
The enemy is the battleship "Astante II"!
What?! The "Astante II," you say?!

Don't let them get close!! All picket
ships, stop the enemy from breaking
through with everything you've got!

Enemy cruiser closing fast! It's the
"Norstan Kai-class" "Renown"!
Lun, open a channel to the "Renown"!
Roger!

Can you hear me? This is Rie Akatsuki,
captain of the Astante!
It's pointless for us to fight each other.

Even if it's only your ship, please, cease
fire!

Captain Rie... I never wanted to fight
you...

But... we have risen up for the future of
Claudia!

Please don't give up hope. We should talk
this out!
They... cut the transmission...
It's no use, Rie! They're soldiers!
Ngh...!

Target, the cruiser Renown! Commence
attack!!

rows.notes: [8] [jp] -> 'Renown' (not in glossary; the English ship name). [4] [jp] read as the Redros officer asking if the lone ship is a defector joining them. [11] Rie says 'Astante' though the ship is the Astante II; kept as written. | [accuracy 9] Rie's honorific for Lun -> plain 'Lun' (late decision 2026-11-01: they are peers) | [proofread 6] punctuation inside the closing quote (unit/corpus convention, as in _00 "Aryuz.")

segments.en:
Renown disabled... It's falling out of the
squadron!

You didn't sink it?! You went easy on them,
Rie! That's held up our advance!!
Ngh...!
All hands, charge!!
It's too late...... At this rate...!

Following the "Renown," the "Grillsen"
has also left the line!

The "Astante II" is still charging
toward us!
Heh... Impressive.

Enemy main fleet confirmed behind the
"Astante II"!!
So they've finally come...

The main body will engage the enemy main
force. Picket ships, withdraw from the
combat area!
Commander... Shall we use that thing?

Yes... First, we'll use the "CS Cannon" to
shatter the enemy fleet's formation in one
blow!

Then I'll have the fleets in the line of
fire pull back.
I leave it to you.
The operation is entering its second phase!

The special attack unit will launch in five
minutes!
Lord Omega, you have sortie orders.
The target?

The battleship Astante. Your orders are to
pin the target ship down in its current
airspace.
Heh... I see.
Omega Fokurosu! Launching!!
All ships, ready guns and torpedoes!!
Target, the enemy main fleet! Open fire!!

rows.notes: [6] [jp] not in glossary: romanized 'Grillsen'. [13] [jp] -> 'CS Cannon' (cf. glossary [jp] Micro CS Cannon). [3] [jp] on a single ship -> 'All hands'. [5] Nelfea's 'too late' presumably refers to the delay before the enemy main body engages. | [proofread 6] punctuation inside the closing quote (unit/corpus convention, as in _00 "Aryuz.")

segments.en:
Our ship will push forward and hold the
"Astante II" in check!!
Captain... let's go over the operation.

Our mission is to stall the "Astante II."
We only need to block its path.
I know that!

This ship is a valuable asset. We can't
afford to lose it.
Obviously!
Zarkful, advance!!
Here they come!

It's the battleship "Zarkful," an
"Astante II Kai-class"!

A brand-new battleship! It's gonna be
tougher than the last one.

We've entered engagement range of the
enemy ship!

As soon as we've checked the surroundings,
we'll launch our machines!
Lun! Anything unusual?

The enemy main force is spreading out while
slowly pulling back.

And on the ground... the energy at Cecibel
Base keeps rising...!
Rie! We've picked it up here too!!
Cecibel Base's CS Cannon is active!!

But wasn't that completely abandoned after
the Third Claudian War?!

This energy coefficient is the real thing!
Hurry and warn the main force!!

(The CS Cannon... the fortress gun at
 Cecibel Base used in the last great war...)

(So they set up here to use that
 thing...!)
Lun! Contact the main fleet, quickly!
Ah, yes!

Rie! What are you doing? Get the Astante
out of there too!

There's an enemy battleship right in front
of us! We can't turn around until we drive
it off!!
Got it! I'll take it down fast!!
Let's go, Nelfea!!
Roger!

rows.notes: [6]/[8] [jp] not in glossary: romanized 'Zarkful'. [17] [jp] 'Third Claudian War' (majority form in existing drafts). [23] Kanji is in the hangar/cockpit, so 'out of there'. | [accuracy 12] Rie's honorific for Lun -> plain 'Lun' (late decision 2026-11-01: they are peers); headerless page, Rie continuing from [11] | [accuracy 21] Rie's honorific for Lun -> plain 'Lun' (late decision 2026-11-01: they are peers) | [editorial 26] address comma; matches row 20 k85 fix in _02 | [proofread 2] punctuation inside the closing quote (unit/corpus convention, as in _00 "Aryuz.") | [proofread 8] punctuation inside the closing quote (unit/corpus convention, as in _00 "Aryuz.")

segments.en:
This blow will raise the curtain on a new
era!

This blow will raise the curtain on a new
era!
Damn you! Binzvanker!!
All ships, emergency evasion! Hurry!!

We're falling into the Sea of Clouds!!
Use every bit of energy we've got and
climb!

Power's dropping!! We can't maintain
altitude!!

The Cloud Stream is rising!! It's eating
through our armor!!
We can't escape!! Captaaain!!
Aaah! It's over!!

Full reverse!! Damage reports from all
sections!!

Ugh... Damage is... heavy... but we can...
still fly.
Kyaaah!!
Rie! Rie!!
Captain Rie! Hang in there!!

...Lun...... take... the helm...
please......
No...... I'm not ready for that yet...!
Rie! Pull yourself together!
Rie!!

Miss Lun!! I can't leave my station
either...! Please!!
All right...
Professor Rondo!! How's the engine room?

Run it at full power! I'll make sure it
holds!!
Just get us to the cliffs somehow!!
Yes! I'll do it!!

Captain Rie has been injured. As this is an
emergency, I am taking command of the ship.

The Astante will now make an emergency
landing.

We're lightening the ship! Jettison all
GTs and supplies into the Sea of Clouds!

Lun!! Keep the ship flying, no matter
what!
Cloud Saber! Launching!!

What are you talking about? At a time like
this!!

I'm going to end it! This fight...
right now!!
Kanji! Stop it!!

The ship'll be lighter by the weight of the
FT and me!
Nooo!! Kanjiii!!
There's still hope... I'm not giving up!
Lun... watch me...
I'll fight this through to the end...
I'm counting on you... partner...!

The operation was a success. Our army's
victory is now assured.

This is only the first phase. Things will
get busy from here.

That composure is exactly what the great
undertaking ahead of us requires.
No one but you could ever accomplish it.
Spare me the flattery...

Once we leave Claudia, you and I will go
separate ways, but proceed as arranged.

For unofficial operations, feel free to
keep using Omega.
Understood.

Your skill is a precious asset to our army.
Forgive me, but I'll be relying on your
help.
Commander! All ships are in position.

Good. We move the operation to the next
phase. Open the Sea of Clouds!

Seal the bulkheads!! All ships, Cloud
System output to maximum!!
What is it?!
A machine approaching from above!!
What? Isn't it Omega?!
Binzvanker!
Your ambitions end right here and now!!
With this one blow!!
I-It's the Cloud Saber!
Anti-aircraft fire!! Put up a barrage!!

It's pointless! All ships, put everything
into opening the Sea of Clouds!!
But sir!

Don't panic!! Battle is a matter of
fortune. Steel yourselves!
Not good enough, Kanji Akatsuki!
This reaction speed... Who are you?!
My name is Omega Fokurosu.

Kanji Akatsuki, if you're a pilot with any
convictions, come with us!

What the hell are you people trying to
do?!!
Heh heh heh heh... Just watch.

Omega's machine has stopped the Cloud Saber!!
They're still fighting!!
Ah, Lord Omega...

The Cloud System has reached saturation!
The Sea of Clouds is opening!!
Splendid...

History is accepting us... That's all
there is to it.

What is that...!! There's a space beneath
the Sea of Clouds?!
What the hell... is going on?!

The times are changing! And all the while,
you people were drunk on a false peace!!
A false peace?!

Peace is something people build
themselves! Whatever form it takes...
it's not false!!

Heh... If you truly want to talk about
peace, throw away your weapons first!

Don't say things you don't mean!! You think
peace can be kept with a simple-minded idea
like that?!!
Hahahahaha! On that, I agree with you.
Then you should be able to understand us!

What'll it be? Will you come with us?
It's not too late yet.

No way! If people like you hadn't shown up,
Claudia would still be at peace!!
Here I come, Omega!!
Heh heh heh...
Where are you aiming?!

I can't lose... I can't lose in a place
like this! Not me!

You've got plenty of fighting spirit, at
least.

But... you will never return to Claudia.
Not ever!!
Feelings alone won't win a fight...
Lord Omega, I'm so glad you're safe.
He gave me a bit of trouble. Returning now!
Ugh... damage report...
Well done, Lun. Excellent work.

The enemy's coming! Give the order to
retreat!!
Right...

Attention, everyone aboard! The Astante can
no longer fly. All hands, abandon ship!

Everyone, get out, quick! As far away as
you can!!
Ugh... Big Bro...

It's all right... Kanji's alive.
I'm sure of it...

Once we fix the ship, we'll go after him.
Okay...!
Ugh... uuugh...
Kanji......
Kanji... You're okay, aren't you...

We'll meet again... We'll definitely meet
again, won't we...
